acme 1.0.0 — Command line for Acme

Manage Acme projects from a terminal or an agent.

Profile: default ({base_url}, org acme, project -, API 2026-01-01)

Usage:
  acme <command> [flags]

Commands:
  auth        Authenticate and inspect credentials
  config      Read and write CLI configuration
  project     Work with projects
  whoami      Show the current user and target
  version     Print the version
  completion  Generate shell completions
  schema      Describe the command tree
  help        Show help

Global flags:
  --json                        Print one JSON document on stdout
  --quiet                       Print identifiers only
  --no-color                    Disable ANSI color (also NO_COLOR)
  --no-input                    Fail instead of prompting
  --yes                         Confirm destructive actions without a prompt
  --dry-run                     Print the request and send nothing
  --debug                       Verbose logs to stderr, redacted
  --timeout <seconds>           Request timeout in seconds (default: 30; env: ACME_TIMEOUT)
  --profile <name>              Config profile (env: ACME_PROFILE)
  --org <id>                    Override the org for this command (env: ACME_ORG)
  --project <id>                Override the project for this command (env: ACME_PROJECT)
  --api-version <version>       Override the pinned API version (env: ACME_API_VERSION)
  --base-url <url>              Override the API base URL (env: ACME_BASE_URL)
  --allow-http                  Allow plain http for a non-loopback host
  --token <token>               API token (prefer ACME_TOKEN) (env: ACME_TOKEN)
  -h, --help                    Show help

Examples:
  acme auth login --token $ACME_TOKEN
  acme project list --limit 5 --json
  acme project get prj_001

Exit codes:
  0 success, 2 usage, 3 auth, 4 forbidden, 5 not found, 6 conflict, 7 rate limit/server, 8 network, 10 confirmation, 11 ambiguous

Docs: https://example.com/acme/docs/cli
